desc: Read input: H, W, X, P, Q, and the grid S.
Initialize current_strength = S[P][Q], visited set with (P,Q), current_pos = (P,Q), in_heap set, and a min-heap for adjacent slimes.
Add all unvisited neighbors of (P,Q) to the heap and in_heap set.
While the heap is not empty:
Pop the smallest strength slime (s, r, c).
If s * X < current_strength, then absorb: update current_strength, mark (r,c) as visited, set current_pos to (r,c), and add all unvisited, not-in-heap neighbors of (r,c) to the heap and in_heap.
